name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature, strategy extraction rule, solver tactic, or benchmark
title: "feat: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

### 1. Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the requested feature.

### 2. Problem / Motivation
Is this related to a specific proof search bottleneck, missing logical connective (e.g. Disjunction, Existential, Equality), or missing toolchain integration?

### 3. Proposed Solution & API
Describe the proposed implementation, data structures, and user-facing API.

### 4. Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] New unit and integration tests added
- [ ] Lean 4 kernel verification passes with zero unverified axioms
- [ ] Benchmark throughput remains within acceptable regression limits
- [ ] Documentation / wiki updated
